recipes.name: High Protein Lettuce Wraps with a Creamy Peanut Sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add the green onion and garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
Then crumble in the tofu with your hands and add the chickpeas. Use the back of the wooden spatula or a fork to mash the chickpeas a bit.
While the tofu continues to cook, prepare the carrots and bell peppers.
Add the bell peppers, carrots, and black bean sauce to the pan. Stir and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until the vegetables are tender but crunchy.
Add the rice noodles to a large bowl and pour boiling water over top. Set aside.
Add all the sauce ingredients to a mason jar and mix. Add more water, if you'd prefer a thinner sauce.
Drain the rice noodles, rinse with warm water, and add to the pan. Toss to combine and let everything heat through. Remove from the stove.
To assemble, take a leaf of lettuce, top with the tofu-noodle mix, drizzle over the peanut sauce, and any other desired toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in the fridge in airtight container s for up to 3 days. Store the lettuce leaves separately from the filling and sauce so that the lettuce remains crisp.
